lines.en: I walk along the dry grassland.
My black fur takes no light from the sun.
Each of my steps is very light.
I head for that low scrub.
I step over the grass.

lines.zh: 我的爪印留得很快又消失
lines.en: My prints appear and fade quickly.
I circle my anchor once.
The wind presses my fur flat.
I stop and look into the distance.
I move with the light behind me.

lines.zh: 我几乎没有声音，火在爪里闷着。
lines.en: I make almost no sound; fire smoulders in my claws.
I pad along the field ridge in moonlight.
I crouch in the grass, hard to see.

lines.zh: 黑毛下，只有我的眼在反光。
lines.en: Under black fur, only my eyes catch light.
I draw my forepaws together.
I'm smelling what's under the grass.
Heat rises off the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙动了一下
lines.en: I lift my head; my throat works.

lines.zh: 尾巴在草里扫出一道痕。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a track through the grass.
I haven't walked all of this ground.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，舌头垂出来。
lines.en: I pant, tongue lolling out.

lines.zh: 我沿着干草场走，黑毛在太阳下没有光。
lines.en: I cross the dry field, black fur giving no light in the sun.
The shadows of the grass move.
I haven't relaxed.
I turn my head to another direction.
It's too bright here in the day.

lines.zh: 黑色的狼人，只在暗处走。
lines.en: A black werewolf keeps to the dark.
I come a little nearer.
My black fur is in the grass.

lines.zh: 黑毛一压，你就看不见了。
lines.en: Black fur low, and you lose sight of me.
I'm not the white one.
My technique is a different one.

lines.zh: 黑色的狼人，站得比马高。
lines.en: A black werewolf, taller than a horse.
Let me see your outline.
Your sword is still sheathed.
I don't like that movement.
One more move and I'm gone.
I've backed into the grass.

lines.zh: 你挂着的铁镐，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the iron pick at your belt.
You're tenser than before.
Around your other side, footsteps silent.
Now I can see you clearly.
I recoil; the grass is churned.
A blow to my ribs makes me snarl.
Blood doesn't show against black fur.
I growl, deep.
I flatten myself lower.
A bloody gash opens in my black fur.
I guard my shoulder.
I shake my coat, blood flicking onto the grass.
I stand straight again.
You landed one.
What's that?

lines.zh: 我偏过头，不再看你手里。
lines.en: I turn my head away from your hand.
This isn't to my taste.
I stand up — taller than prey.
I prefer what I catch myself.
Put it down and I'll take it myself.
I glance once and turn away.

lines.zh: 那点东西，塞不住我的牙。
lines.en: That scrap won't fill the gap in my teeth.
That buys nothing.
I have other things to do.
That isn't nearly enough.
I've no interest.
One turn and I slip aside.

lines.zh: 你撞来，黑毛下的肩一顶。
lines.en: You charge; the shoulder under my black fur shoves back.
I brush your knee and don't stop.
The grass is flattened where we stood.
I brace on my hind legs and steady.
My fur is coarse.
Where you touched is a little cold.

lines.zh: 我的黑毛蹭过你的护腕。
lines.en: My black fur rubs across your bracer.
Better not to reach out.
I bite.
I'm not easily approached.
Our kind keeps to themselves.
If you follow, make no sound.
The grass is safest.
By day I hide; by night I move.
You may come along.
But don't expect me to wait.
I go by deeds.
If you can, keep up.
At dawn we part.
I bite down and shake my head twice.

lines.zh: 我前爪按住，低头闻了闻。
lines.en: I pin it with a forepaw and sniff.
I can tear you open standing still.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，钻进高草深处。
lines.en: I take it in my jaws and slip into the tall grass.
Too heavy; I let it go.
I sniff it and drop it.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它扒进草丛。
lines.en: I rake it into the grass with a claw.
You dropped it. I won't touch it.
I bury it under the grass roots.
I go on my way.
The wind bends the grass; I smell blood.

lines.zh: 两只耳朵转向声音那头。
lines.en: Both ears turn toward the sound.
The scent comes from there.
I crouch, claws digging into grass roots.
My fur matches the grass.

lines.zh: 黑狼人的爪子，收得很轻。
lines.en: The black werewolf's claws stay quiet.
I circle, waiting for you to turn.
My feet fall between the stalks.
Its back is to me.
That's my chance.

lines.zh: 我四爪蹬地，草往两边倒。
lines.en: I push off and the grass bends aside.
The grass closes behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，它一动我就停。
lines.en: I move low; the moment it shifts, I stop.
When it moves, I stop.
I wait for it to turn away.
Only five paces left.
I keep my breathing shallow.
Tron Flame is ready.
Its shadow is on the ground.
I move through the shadow.
It's close against the grass now.
I'm in position.
This strike comes from the side.
I move.
Tron Flame sweeps out.
Dark light cuts across the grass.
It's knocked backward.
I bring a claw down on its nape.
One paw pins its shoulder.
It wrenches free.
I retreat into the grass.
There are scorch marks in the grass.
It can't find me.
I'm at its rear flank.
One more will do.
It's withdrawn.

lines.zh: 草一动，我站直了，比你还高。
lines.en: The grass stirs; I stand taller than you.
Grass seed clings to my black fur.
The anchor is in this ground.
First I crouch and listen.
There are several scents in the wind.
None of them close.
Black werewolf, claws honed.
By daylight I'd rather not move.
But first I must learn the ground.
I circle halfway around.
The grass is tall enough to hide me.
I walk slowly in.
Fire catches my fur; I roll in the grass.
I nearly fail to land cleanly.

lines.zh: 水一淹，我的毛全贴在身上
lines.en: Submerged, my fur plasters to me.

lines.zh: 我被气浪掀得滚了一圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over once.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的侧腹
lines.en: Something lodges in my flank.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的毛炸开
lines.en: This force makes my fur bristle.
Too long since I caught anything.
In the lightning my fur lights up.
The grass is gone, and I fall.
